# kno pricingcheck SYNTHETIC broken fixtures
# Hand-built, deliberately broken, to drive the detector's error paths.
# None of these pretend to be a real capture.

anthropic-batch.html
  purpose: two tables carry the committed header literal -> errSelect,
  check 2 FAIL (selection is ambiguous)

anthropic-shifted.html
  purpose: header cells shifted one right -> zero matches -> errSelect,
  check 2 FAIL (no table selected)

anthropic-duplicated.html
  purpose: header row duplicated as a data row -> errRow, check 3 FAIL

anthropic-badcell.html
  purpose: a data row with five cells -> errRow, check 3 FAIL

openrouter-bad.json
  purpose: wrong envelope (no "data" array) -> errShape, exit 2 in
  fixture mode
